scope: ResidueEncoding.coefficient_equiv_exists, residue_formula and modular_buffer_card; no compiler, bit-operation cost, tensor or ECDLP asymptotic claim.
statement: The concrete coefficient quotient A/(2^p) is ring-equivalent to ZMod2^p, its encoding is numerator times inverse denominator, and length-q modular buffers have exactly2^(p*q) states.
